testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.review: My son was hooked from the very first free trial session. The educators at Galileo Multiverse explain complex astrophysics concepts with such simplicity, fun visuals, and real excitement. Best online science academy for kids!

testimonials.name: Rajesh Kumar
testimonials.review: The Junior Astronomer program is extraordinary. My daughter now talks about black holes, gravitational waves, and exoplanets with genuine understanding. Thank you Abhishek sir and team!

testimonials.name: Ananya Sengupta
testimonials.review: Sunday Space Club is our favorite weekly routine. The live telescope sessions and Q&A with real scientists keep curiosity burning bright. Highly recommended to every young stargazer.

testimonials.name: Vikram Patel
testimonials.review: Career-oriented program is top notch. The depth of celestial mechanics and practical astronomical tools they teach gave my son clear guidance towards pursuing astrophysics at ISRO.
